label: FastH3 Omni (8-step H3, up to 8 subjects)

template._note: H3 renders 17k+5 frames, at most 3592; width and height must be multiples of 32.

continuous._note: docs/CONTINUOUS.md. `latent`: the previous take's last `overlap` frames (rounded up to 17j+5) held at the head of the render, video and audio, by H3ChainLatent between `sampler`'s `input` and its source; it reads the previous take's kept latent, else encodes its last frames through the VAEs. The held frames are trimmed off before the saver (H3ChainTrim). `continuous: first` needs a first keyframe, which Omni doesn't read: such a shot builds on `first` (H3 FL2VA) instead, unless it names its own target.

multishot._note: As Ref2VA's: H3's timed [Shot N] sections (docs/MULTISHOT.md; the three-shot proof, 2026-10-26, cut at 4.583 s and 6.083 s for 4.458 and 6.083). One plate a generation: the group's first shot's.

recipe._note: As Ref2VA's (its compile and prompt are Ref2VA's, minimax_h3_ref2va/compile.py), with the node's nine picture sockets: Pictures 1-8 are the shot's subjects (characters first, then props and vehicles, in script order), Picture 9 is always the location plate. A shot with fewer subjects fills the rest with 32x32 grey placeholders (comfy_nodes/shotplan.py), so the plate stays <Picture 9>. Each character is fed ONE panel of its 4-panel sheet, as on Ref2VA. Clone mode feeds one voice sample per speaker, at most 3.

retention._note: H3's audio retention markers, and the IR's neutral `preserve` mapped onto them. fully_copy makes a dub slice the whole soundtrack; partially_copy copies the voices and lets H3 add foley; reference only borrows timbre and timing.

size_hints.voice sample: 5-15 seconds of clean speech, mono wav

binding._note: Ref2VA's workflow with FastH3's model chain: the Omni checkpoint, no turbo LoRA (LoRAs a shot names go in after UNETLoader), MiniMaxH3SigmaShift 12 / 3 (FastVideo's video and audio shifts: the conversion notes say not to reuse V2's 10), and ComfyUI's own BlockSparseAttention in `vsa` mode at 10% (the checkpoint carries VSA's to_gate_compress layers, trained at 10) in place of the SLA node Ref2VA's turbo LoRAs want. The Shot Loader's ref_4..ref_8 (its last outputs) feed ref_image_3..7 and ref_bg ref_image_8. Guider CFG 1 (BasicGuider), as FastVideo's guidance_scale 1.0.

models._note: The family each model param must be (targets/modelid.py). FastH3 Omni is told from the other H3 checkpoints by its VSA gate tensors, so a Ref2VA or FL2VA file is refused here (and this one there). No turbo LoRA: the model is distilled to 8 steps itself. text_encoder / video_vae / audio_vae are H3's own, shared with Ref2VA (`default`).

presets._note: FastVideo's recipe (the FastH3-Omni-Comfy model card and its receipt's source_contract): 8 steps, guidance 1.0, video shift 12, audio shift 3 (the shifts are the workflow's). The proxy keeps all 8 steps (a step-distilled model does best at its own count) and saves its time on size and `ref_image_size: match`, as Ref2VA's does.

upscale._note: h3upscale.py: a final take re-sampled at `scale` from `start` (a fraction of its own schedule: 0.875 is step 7 of 8), its latent's video upscaled by `upscaler` (the LBH-123-AI Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler pack, not the Plus fork: temporal chunking must stay on). The loader's resolution_override carries the new size into the conditioning.

windows._note: A re-sample of a take longer than `seconds` (5.5: the 4.5-5.2 s shots fit one pass at 2688x1536, longer ones risk running out of memory) is sampled in windows (h3upscale.windowed): obvpm's H3 Context Windowing (comfyui-obvpm-timeline), MultiDiffusion along time with pyramid weights over each overlap, so 1344x768 x2 (2688x1536, about twice the pixels of the 1920x1088 the pack measured at ~7 GB of activations per 5 s window) fits 32 GB. The series' upscale recipe's `window` overrides the length (0: off).

downloads._note: Where to get each file this target names (docs/API.md 'Downloads'). A url is only given when a trustworthy record has it: a ComfyUI template's or saved workflow's properties.models entry, or ComfyUI-Manager's model list; `source` says which. Otherwise url is null and source says what to search for. Never a guessed URL.
